mechanism_narrative: The recent rebound in WORKPLACES mobility lifts weekday foot traffic and lunch-time shopping, so RETAIL_REC rises over the next four weeks as commuting density continues to recover.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not exceed its last-4-week mean over the next 28 days despite WORKPLACES staying above the t-1w level for at least two of those weeks.

mechanism_narrative: When TRANSIT improves enough to cross above its prior two-week average, more people can reach shopping districts, and RETAIL_REC increases within two weeks after the crossing.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT rises above its mean of the prior 2 weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC is not higher over the following 14 days after a TRANSIT crossing event, or the increase occurs without the crossing condition.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in GROCERY_PHARM and RESIDENTIAL indicates more local, home-centered errands and less discretionary shopping, which suppresses RETAIL_REC over the next week.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 7 days while both GROCERY_PHARM and RESIDENTIAL are at or above their current-week levels.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp improvement in PARKS followed by retail spillovers signals broader outing propensity, so RETAIL_REC rises over the next four weeks after people resume discretionary trips.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises by more than 5 points week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC remains flat or declines over the next 28 days after a PARKS increase of more than 5 points from one week to the next.

mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES keep rising while RESIDENTIAL keeps falling, the city is shifting out of stay-at-home behavior and into out-of-home consumption, which pushes RETAIL_REC up over four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not outperform its prior 4-week average over the next 28 days even though WORKPLACES rises and RESIDENTIAL falls for at least two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in GROCERY_PHARM below its recent baseline reflects substitution away from essential local trips toward discretionary shopping, which increases RETAIL_REC within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM falls below its mean of the prior 2 weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase in the 14 days after GROCERY_PHARM falls below its prior-two-week mean.

mechanism_narrative: In a warm-weather visitation regime, gains in PARKS and TRANSIT jointly predict more weekend and leisure trips, so RETAIL_REC rises over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to rise over the next 28 days while both PARKS and TRANSIT remain above their t-1w levels.

mechanism_narrative: When TRANSIT keeps falling while RESIDENTIAL keeps rising, the city is in a containment-like mobility pattern that reduces discretionary shopping visits and lowers RETAIL_REC over the next week.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline over the next 7 days when TRANSIT falls and RESIDENTIAL rises simultaneously.
